# Safer with Jev

> Public showcases of TypeSafe Jev judgments: yes/no questions, prompt injections, and assistant replies.

## Documentation

- [API documentation](https://safer-with-jev.com/AGENTS.md): Request formats, responses, limits and forwarding behavior.
- [Newspaper landing](https://safer-with-jev.com/): Human-facing examples.

## API

- [API host](https://api.safer-with-jev.com/): Send inspect and forwarding requests here.

The site host serves the newspaper landing. The API host serves JSON and forwarding responses.
Inspection requires no Safer API key.
GET /ask-jev uses q and t. GET /nice-try uses p.
POST /block-prompt-injections and /block-unsafe-replies accept text.
Image-caption judging is a listed Jev use case. This showcase does not accept image bytes.
Forwarding requires a caller-supplied target and destination credentials.
Use throwaway content. GET query strings can appear in history and logs.
